response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and geospatial development experience, particularly with his GISCollective project, which aligns well with the geospatial focus of the role. However, his recent work heavily favors TypeScript/Node.js, and while he has C++ experience, it is not recent or prominently featured in his recent roles. His problem-solving and experimentation skills are evident, but the lack of direct routing/navigation system experience and limited recent C++ work are concerns.
strengths: Extensive geospatial development experience, particularly with GISCollective, an open-source Geo-Data platform.
Proven ability to design and build scalable, event-driven systems with a focus on data integrity and automation.
Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to expand expertise, as demonstrated by diverse technical contributions and workshops.
concerns: Primary expertise in TypeScript/Node.js and JavaScript ecosystems, with limited recent C++ or Rust experience.
No direct experience with routing/navigation systems or real-time traffic integration, which are core to the role.
Recent roles emphasize full-stack development and AI-agent infrastructure, diverging from the low-latency, high-reliability focus of this position.
